headline: UPS Releases 2Q 2026 Earnings
summary: ATLANTA, July 28, 2026--UPS (NYSE:UPS) today announced second-quarter 2026 consolidated revenues of $22.8 billion. Consolidated operating profit was $930 million; and non-GAAP adjusted consolidated operating profit was $2.1 billion. Diluted earnings per share were $0.71; and non-GAAP adjusted diluted earnings per share were $1.76.

headline: United Parcel Service (NYSE:UPS) Surprises With Strong Q2 CY2026, Full-Year Outlook Slightly Exceeds Expectations
summary: Parcel delivery company UPS (NYSE:UPS) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 7.4% year on year to $22.8 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $91.2 billion at the midpoint came in 0.9% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.76 per share was 5.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
